    1980

    Rooted in Lancaster County, growing with you.

    Audrey’s Home & Gift was founded in 1980 by Ken and Audrey Mull in Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, from a passion for creating handcrafted products. What started as a small, creative endeavour has grown into a trusted wholesale partner for independent retailers across the country.

    We still carry the farmhouse and cottage-inspired pieces that built the brand, alongside fresh, on-trend collections developed for evolving retail trends and a broader customer audience.
